text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you're going to light 
up instead? …Just so you know, it's 
much harder than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I run up the outside stairs and react 
to the lights on. Now I can see the 
lights climbing to the top.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, since the stairs are split into 
two, we can't see each other…… In other 
words, we can't run up the stairs at 
the right time with our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In other words,
you have to move at a steady 
speed, in perfect synchrony.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Can you say for sure?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…Is it possible for the two of you to trust
us 
and leave it to us?

text_block_list.name: Event Manager
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course! If you two say so…!
I'm sorry to 
burden you, but I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. …Didn't you hear? 
There's no time until the light-up 
ceremony. You guys warm up.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the two of them won't be able to attend 
the ceremony. Instead,
we need to make room for 
them right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What I'm thinking is that Brian and I are
going 
to present the GIRLS LEGEND U――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wait! Can I do that? I'll perform 
on stage! No, let me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's not a problem… Is it okay to be
alone?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Both Airgrove and Brian should be on standby
in 
case something happens, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry.
I think I'll be able to put on an 
amazing performance today.
I'll sing with my 
precious feelings. …What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…If you want to satisfy the audience,
I don't 
mind. Brian, what about you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll do what I want. So…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Brian… Just watch. Just watch me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'm off, then!

text_block_list.name: Event Moderator
text_block_list.text:
――Finally,
the lighting ceremony begins after 
this! Before that……this time,
we're going to 
perform one song as a surprise!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …What is she thinking?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You want to catch your breath,
don't you? You 
seem to have lost your fangs recently,
even from 
my perspective. …I can tell you're hurt.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Laurel will tell you… 
No, she'll know soon enough.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't take your eyes off me. It's the 
responsibility of those who become the symbol
of 
their goal to face the resolve to face
them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(―I'm going to show everyone my feelings.
And 
I'm going to show you…!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(There were so many things I had to 
give up on. My hopes for everyone, 
who withered without budding.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Still,
I can't give up. I can't give up. I have 
to have you stay here.
An absolute light――)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: 『――I want to win with you!』

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Look at me, Brian. The last 
thing you see is my light.)

text_block_list.name: Event Moderator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel,
thank you very much! Your voice 
was full of spirit and spirit!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…Hmm? Looks like Laurel's 
feelings have reached you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
…Anyway,
the real problem is after this. Vodka 
and Scarlet run up the stairs―

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …I'll run at my own pace. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hah, do that! I'll run like myself.
That's how 
I've always been.

text_block_list.name: Event Manager
text_block_list.text: Vodka, Scarlet! Please stand by!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Okay, I'll go with tappen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Laurel,
good work. That was a good performance.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! So,
what about Vodka and the others?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's about to start.
I run up the stairs leading 
from the ground to the observation deck,
and 
reproduce the lights―

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Brian, can you do it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't train to match someone else's speed,
and 
I can't see them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But you think those two can do it, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's Vodka and Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Event Moderator
text_block_list.text:
――And so,
about this lighting……what a surprise! 
The two Ambassadors will actually be lighting
it!

text_block_list.name: Event Moderator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
please pay attention to Hallon Tower!
